fields.FIR_Description: As per the complaint recorded on 2026-08-25, copper cables and fittings valued at around Rs. 1,20,000 was found missing from a premises near Iniyan Colony Apartment Complex. The time of the incident was given as 20:20 on 2026-08-25. The online submission was made by Vasanthi Ammal (9000000479). Vasanth Gopal (9000000245), described as a co-worker, was also mentioned in the complaint. The complainant alleged that Venkat Palanisamy may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000134. Potentially relevant material referenced includes physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly entered through an unsecured entry point.
fields.Keywords: property theft, valuables, mobile number, documents, associate, apartment complex, evening, suspect
